g.text: How much of the perfect-knowledge opportunity does the real detector recover?

g.text: Captured gain = (H-Nav − Native) ÷ (Oracle − Native) on the conflicted stratum.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Computable only where an oracle arm exists. sh_64k has none, so it cannot appear here — and these two ratios may not be transferred to it.
